scope: Block 10 minimal physical ocean-to-SAR forward model

real_data_benchmark.role: real-data benchmark only; never used to set synthetic parameters
real_data_benchmark.interpretation: The unique-bin ridge is much flatter than finite-depth dispersion. After k is included, the standardized angle effect is small relative to the k effect; overlapping patches preclude independent-bin inference.

radar_geometry.mapping_equation: y_SAR = y + (R/V) u_LOS for u_LOS positive toward sensor
radar_geometry.sign_derivation: Positive velocity toward the sensor is negative range-rate; zero-Doppler location shifts in positive along-track image coordinate by +(R/V)u_LOS.

physical_formulation.surface: eta=sum a cos(k dot x-omega t+phi)
physical_formulation.dispersion: omega^2=g k tanh(k h0), h0=10 m
physical_formulation.LOS_projection: u_LOS=sin(incidence) u_range + cos(incidence) w, positive toward sensor
physical_formulation.jacobian: J=1+(R/V) partial u_LOS/partial y; M3/M4 use conservative forward splatting and retain multi-source folds
physical_formulation.temporal_look: rectangular slow-time brightness average by Gauss-Legendre quadrature

range_0deg.temporal_average: 9-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature of a rectangular look

vandenberg_like_22deg.temporal_average: 9-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature of a rectangular look

criterion.trigger: mean slope for 1.5 and 2 s exceeds the 6 s slope by at least max(0.5 m/s, 10% of truth slope), with all six components valid
criterion.reason: This tests a material predicted re-emergence of dispersion rather than responding to small numerical fluctuations.

frozen_short_look_prediction.prediction: No material short-look increase in domega_hat/dk is predicted by this model.
frozen_short_look_prediction.authorized_real_action: Do not process new Vandenberg short looks; the predeclared trigger failed.
